articles.title: SonicWall Warns of Potential In-the-Wild Exploitation of SSLVPN Flaw That Bypasses MFA
articles.summary:
SonicWall has warned customers to patch a SonicOS SSLVPN vulnerability that could let attackers bypass SAML authentication and its multi-factor authentication checks. Tracked as CVE-2026-19868, the flaw carries a CVSS score of 7.1. The company has investigated a report indicating potential exploitation and strongly urges customers to upgrade promptly. articles.title: Claude Code’s “Yes, and Don’t Ask Again” Option Can Leak Passwords and API Keys to GitHub
articles.summary:
Claude Code’s “Yes, and don’t ask again” option can save passwords and API keys inside project settings that later reach public GitHub repositories. Apiiro researchers found 2,539 distinct secrets across 1,994 public repositories, showing how a routine approval can turn private credentials into public data. The research identified 63 affected organizations, mostly software companies. Exposed […]
